title: 第一卷 第17章 不知道的还以为你们是集体来讨饭的呢第一卷 第18章 你们今天必须给个说法
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 玉元震那堪称恐怖的雷霆威压铺天盖地砸下来，整个七宝琉璃宗广场顿时乱成了一锅粥。
“我的天，这老怪物怎么真来了！”
“快趴下！
别被雷劈了！”
大半宾客被震得气血翻涌，修为在魂宗以下的，好几个直接一头栽倒在桌子底下，连滚带爬地往外躲。
主桌这边，象甲宗的呼延震猛地往嘴里灌了一大口酒，压住胸口翻腾的气血，眼睛瞪得像铜铃。
而坐在另一侧的武魂殿主教萨拉斯，此时虽然也被这威压弄得脸色发白。
但在长长的袖袍掩盖下，手却激动得直哆嗦。
老天开眼啊。
他这几天正为了怎么试探七宝琉璃宗的底牌而发愁，教皇殿那边催得又紧。
直接上去问？
他萨拉斯还没这么蠢笨！
派人潜入？
七宝琉璃宗本部现在被剑骨两位斗罗防得跟铁桶一样。
结果今天，这头暴脾气的老龙居然自己送上门来当出头鸟了！
“闹吧，闹得越大越好。”
萨拉斯低下头，掩盖住脸上那幸灾乐祸的表情。
“今天这一闹，七宝琉璃宗和蓝电霸王宗的关系怕是直接就要僵了。”
“而且，老夫倒要看看，你尘心是不是真的弄到了十万年魂环。”
半空中，玉元震周身的蓝色雷电越发狂躁。
就在所有人都以为七宝琉璃宗的人要大发雷霆时，高台上的宁天却突然啧了一声。
宁天从魂导器里摸出一个扩音喇叭，放在嘴边。
“上面那个挂着一身雷的，你就是蓝电霸王龙宗的玉元震老宗主吧？”
声音经过放大，在乱哄哄的广场上炸响，清晰地传入每个人耳朵里。
玉元震低头瞥了他一眼，没吭声。
宁天可不管那个，直接开喷。
“我说玉老前辈，你这都一大把年纪了，半截身子都入土的人了，怎么连点基本的人情世故都不懂？”
“今天是什么日子？是我宁天娶媳妇的大喜日子！”
“你看看底下这上千桌酒席，整个天斗帝国有头有脸的人物都在这儿沾喜气。”
“你倒好，带着几十号人，踩着乌云过来，还到处乱放电！”
宁天拿着喇叭，指着天上的玉元震，语气里全是鄙夷。
“知道的，明白你是来讨教切磋的。”
“不知道的，还以为你们蓝电霸王龙宗快破产了，实在揭不开锅，跑到我七宝琉璃宗的婚宴上组团要饭来了呢！”
“不让人吃，是想等下全部打包回去吗？”
此话一出，全场鸦雀无声。
连躲在桌子底下的人都忍不住探出头来，一脸活见鬼的表情看着台上那个废柴少主。
疯了吧？
那可是九十五级的强攻系封号斗罗啊！
全大陆第一兽武魂的拥有者！
你一个连魂环都没有的普通人，指着人家鼻子骂要饭的？
content_en:
Yu Yuan Zhen's terrifying thunder pressure came down overwhelmingly, and the entire Qibao Glazed Sect Square suddenly turned into a mess.
"Oh my god, why is this old monster really here!"
“Get down quickly!
Don't be struck by lightning! "
Most of the guests were shocked to the point where their energy and blood surged, and several of those with cultivation levels below Soul Sect fell directly under the table, rolling and crawling to hide outside.
At the main table, Hu Yanzhen from the Xiangjia Sect took a big gulp of wine into his mouth, suppressing the blood boiling in his chest, and his eyes were as wide as copper bells.
Salas, the Bishop of Wuhun Palace sitting on the other side, turned pale at this time even though he was under such pressure.
But under the cover of the long sleeves, his hands were shaking with excitement.
God opens your eyes.
He has been worrying about how to test the Seven Treasures Glazed Sect's trump card these days, and the Pope's Palace is pressing hard.
Just go up and ask?
Salas is not so stupid!
Send someone to infiltrate?
The headquarters of Qibao Glazed Sect is now defended like an iron barrel by the two Douluo Jiangu.
As a result, today, this grumpy old dragon actually showed up to show off on his own!
"Let's make a fuss. The bigger the fuss, the better."
Salas lowered his head to hide the gloating expression on his face.
"With today's commotion, the relationship between the Qibao Glazed Sect and the Blue Lightning Overlord Sect will probably come to a standstill."
"Besides, I would like to see if your Chen Xin has really obtained a hundred thousand year soul ring."
In mid-air, the blue thunder and lightning around Yu Yuanzhen became more and more manic.
Just when everyone thought that the people from the Qibao Glazed Sect were going to be furious, Ning Tian on the high platform suddenly let out a tut.
Ning Tian took out a loudspeaker from the soul guide and put it to his mouth.
"The one above with the thunder hanging all over you, you are the old sect leader Yu Yuanzhen of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Sect, right?"
The sound was amplified and boomed in the noisy square, clearly reaching everyone's ears.
Yu Yuanzhen glanced down at him and said nothing.
Ning Tian didn't care about that and just started spraying.
"Senior Yu, you are already quite old and half of your body is buried in the ground. How come you don't even understand basic human relations?"
"What day is today? It's a happy day for me, Ning Tian, to marry my wife!"
"Look at the thousands of banquet tables down there. All the prominent people in the Tiandou Empire are here to enjoy themselves."
"It's better for you to bring dozens of people here under the dark clouds and discharge electricity everywhere!"
Ning Tian took the trumpet and pointed at Yu Yuanzhen in the sky, his tone full of contempt.
"I know, I understand that you are here for advice and discussion."
"For those of you who don't know, I thought your Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Sect was about to go bankrupt. You couldn't bring yourself to reveal the cause, so you came to my Qibao Glazed Sect's wedding banquet to form a group to beg for food!"
"If you don't let people eat it, do you want to pack it all back later?"
As soon as these words came out, the whole place was silent.
Even the people hiding under the table couldn't help but poke their heads out, looking at the good-for-nothing young master on the stage with a ghostly expression.
Crazy?
That was a level ninety-five power attack titled Douluo!
The owner of the best beast spirit in the continent!
You, an ordinary person who doesn't even have a soul ring, point your nose at others and scold them for asking for food?
